UPPSC LT Grade Assistant Teacher Mains Admit Card 2026 : Important Question
Q. When will the UPPSC LT Grade Mains Admit Card 2026 be released? A. The admit card is released before the exam date . Candidates should regularly check the official UPPSC website.

Q. How can I download my answer key? A. Visit the UPPSC official website , navigate to the answer key / Download section, enter your Registration Number / Roll Number and Date of Birth / Password , then download and print the admit card.
Q. What details are mentioned on the admit card? A. Candidate’s name, roll number, photograph, signature, exam date, time, exam center, and important instructions .

UPPSC LT Grade Assistant Teacher Mains Admit Card 2026

Post Date: August 12, 2026

11:06 am

Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the Mains Admit Card on its official website for the recruitment of Assistant Teacher (TGT) posts. The Music Mains Exam will be conducted on 11 July 2026. The UPPSC Computer mains application process started on 23 June 2026, and candidates were able to submit their applications until 07 July 2026. Candidates can download their Music Mains Admit Card using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct link is provided below.. Advt No : A-5/E-1/2025
